sloka: यदि वो रोचते वृत्तम् जनकस्य महात्मनः ।पुरीम् गच्छामहे शीघ्रम् मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ॥१-६८-१७॥
transliteration: yadi vo rocate vṛttam janakasya mahātmanaḥ ।purīm gacchāmahe śīghram mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ ॥1-68-17॥

translations.english: "The enhancer of the joy of Kausalya (Rama) along with hs brother Lakshmana under the protection of Viswamitra is now staying in the coutry of the Videhas."
